citation.authors: Gillies D, Maiocchi L, Bhandari AP, Taylor F et al

cited_by.title: Childhood trauma and where to start

record.population: 51 randomised trials with 6,201 children and adolescents who had been exposed to trauma (sexual abuse in 12 trials, war or community violence in 10, other traumas in the rest)
record.design: Cochrane systematic review of psychological therapies versus control
record.finding: Psychological therapy cut the chance of a PTSD diagnosis, compared with no treatment, usual care or waiting list, for up to a month after therapy (odds ratio 0.51, 95% CI 0.34 to 0.77). Seventeen trials used cognitive-behavioural therapy and two EMDR.
record.note: The abstract text I opened gave the short-term result; the medium- and long-term results and the certainty rating were cut off. Trial populations were mixed and the abstract does not give the share who were Black.
